goal: Let a profile set each verification check to off, observe or enforce in the policy agentfiles writes, so a new check ships logging and Beau turns it to enforce with one line (agent-kit R32, run 2026-11-27-r32-hook-gates).
changed: policy.checks maps a check id (commit-gate, stop-checks, spec-drift, receipts, test-guard) to off, observe or enforce. The highest mode across profiles, agentfiles.yaml and local.yaml wins; a check nobody names observes; an unknown id or mode is refused, and a bare YAML off counts as off.

sync writes the map to ~/.agents/policy.yaml as plain id: 'mode' lines, and status prints the modes. A project's .agents/policy.yaml may set a check lower; it parses and the user's mode still applies.
The builder profile allows bstack's hooks, as Beau decided in agent-kit H14.

claims.claim: Modes merge to the strictest, an unknown id or mode is refused, the rendered file reads back exactly and ends in plain id lines, local.yaml can raise a check but not lower it, and a lower project mode leaves the user's in force.
claims.check: make test (tests/test_policy.py adds five tests and four refusal cases)
claims.remaining: Beau's real profiles set no check yet, so the synced file on his machine has no checks key and every check observes.

claims.claim: With the allow line, a sync of the builder profile installs bstack natively in Claude Code.
claims.check: agentfiles plan builder in this worktree (no local.yaml), bstack lines
claims.remaining: On Beau's Mac, local.yaml sends agent-kit only to Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and pi, and Claude Code takes bstack from the agent-kit marketplace, so this line changes nothing there.

next.item: bstack's commit gate and Stop hook read policy.checks
next.why_now: The mode exists now; nothing reads it yet.
next.impact: A commit without verification and a red tree at stop get logged, then stopped once Beau sets enforce.

release.note: A profile can set each verification check to off, observe or enforce under policy.checks; the strictest mode wins. builder allows bstack's hooks.
